en.t: The time when they might meet again was distant and impossible to know.

units.source_text: 思想起来，好不愁闷人也！”

en.t: When one thought about it, how deeply depressing it was!

units.source_text: 诸如此类，源氏公子对每一个情人，都殷勤慰问，无微不至。

en.t: In this way, Prince Genji sent kind and attentive words of comfort to every one of his lovers, neglecting no detail.
